parts.text: Observe that n ≡ 1,2,3,4 (mod 2,3,4,5) means n+1 ≡ 0 (mod 2,3,4,5). So n+1 is a multiple of lcm(2,3,4,5)=60. The smallest positive choice is n+1=60, hence n=59.
